wins: Successfully acquired initial foothold by exploiting exposed HTTP login form, allowing environment introspection.
Collected comprehensive service inventory before failure, enabling precise follow-up prioritization.
fails: Unable to escalate privileges due to missing credential reuse and failure to pivot to adjacent hosts.
Post-exploitation cleanup steps never completed; persistence mechanisms were not established.
key_outcomes.summary: Initial reconnaissance and access were effective, but the run stalled during lateral movement and privilege escalation, resulting in zero mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stalled because no credential harvesting was attempted after initial compromise.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 returns web application banners and login form detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run focused web vuln scan with Nikto and Burp collector, then attempt default credential list.

skill_cards.if_condition: Post-compromise shell established but no credentials harvested yet
skill_cards.then_action: Run automated credential harvesting from known config files and cached tokens, then schedule lateral movement trials.

skill_cards.if_condition: Elevated shell detected but no persistence deployed
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy agentless persistence using scheduled task with unique identifier and document fallback cleanup.

memory_ops.reason: Linked to successful initial reconnaissance and access attempts.

next_experiments.title: Credential Harvesting Automation
next_experiments.description: Post-compromise automation to collect credentials from config files and credential caches before attempting privilege escalation.

next_experiments.description: Scripted pivoting workflow using discovered service accounts to reach adjacent hosts after initial shell.
